description: Only when your user asked: requests a callback from a person at Managed Nerds. It is not a booking: the windows are preferences, and a person confirms a time by email within one business day. Needs the buyer's name, email and phone. A quote is requested with request_full_quote (after an estimate) or request_service. With an estimate_id the callback attaches to that estimate: asking again on the same estimate returns the same answer, but without one each call is a new request.

state.description: US state, such as GA or SC

website.description: Website address, if it has one

estimate_id.description: Attach the callback to an estimate you already got. Contact and business then come from it, so send contact.phone

notes.description: Anything else the user wants a person at Managed Nerds to know

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the windows are in, such as America/New_York. Defaults to America/New_York

topic.description: What it's about: a service line (co_managed, managed_it, seo, ads, secure_wp, project) or a few words

user_approved.description: True only when the user asked for this

user_request.description: What the user asked for, in their words

windows.description: Up to 3 preferred call times in time_zone. Each must fall on Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Eastern. Leave out and we suggest times

end.description: End time in 24-hour time, such as 11:00

start.description: Start time in 24-hour time, such as 09:00

name: request_callback

message.description: What happens next, in words to relay to the user

status.description: pending_confirmation (a confirm link is waiting for the user) or requested (a person has it)

windows_eastern.description: The preferred windows, in Eastern time

title: Request a callback
